## Checkpoint recovery provenance

The first update-1908 checkpoint save to the network volume produced an unreadable
container and was never accepted. It is retained in the checkpoint quarantine. The
run resumed from the strictly reopened update-1861 recovery checkpoint with the exact
expected next-batch and next-stream hashes, then replayed updates 1862–1908. GPU
numerics were not bitwise identical to the abandoned in-memory attempt (maximum pass-
loss delta 0.000180379; maximum effective-gate delta 0.0000607185), so both 47-row
traces are preserved. Every final result uses the replayed trajectory and the accepted
checkpoint at `/workspace/exp2d3a_run/checkpoints/scientific_cumulative_001000341504.pt`.
That persistent checkpoint has SHA-256
`de80d0886a42e4142fa8b30d27eae4302a298bb207961b593f9401e908faaf7b`
and independently passed all 15 strict reopen checks.
